statement: The public community DS4 summary describes the USB full-state input as 0x01/64 bytes with LX/LY/RX/RY, hat/face, shoulders/other buttons, analog triggers, signed motion samples, timestamp and packed touch contacts. The independent OpenPuck implementation is a compatible-device lead, not retail packet confirmation.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: Community playstation.md lines 20–42. Full bit-level descriptor and retail revision differences await PS4 wiki export.
